units.source_text: 不過，比起這封信，我最直接的痛苦是手頭拮据，

en.t: However, more than that letter, my most immediate suffering was being short of money,

units.source_text: 以及地下運動的任務越來越激烈和忙碌，使我再也無法以半當遊戲的心態去面對了。

en.t: and the work of the underground movement grew so intense and busy that I could no longer face it in a half-playful frame of mind.

units.source_text: 不知該稱中央區還是什麼區，

en.t: I do not know whether it was called the Central District or some other district,

units.source_text: 我當上了包括本鄉、小石川、下谷、神田那一帶所有學校的馬克思學生隊的隊長。

en.t: I had become the captain of a Marxist student squad covering all the schools around Hongo, Koishikawa, Shitaya, and Kanda.

units.source_text: 聽說要搞武裝暴動，我買了一把小刀

en.t: When I heard there would be an armed uprising, I bought a small knife

units.source_text: （現在想來，那不過是一把細弱得連鉛筆都削不好的小刀），

en.t: (now that I think of it, it was merely a flimsy little knife that could hardly sharpen a pencil),

units.source_text: 把它裝進雨衣的口袋裡四處奔走，以便進行所謂的「聯絡」。

en.t: put it into the pocket of my raincoat, and ran here and there carrying out so-called contacts.

units.source_text: 多想一醉方休，大睡一覺，可手頭沒錢。

en.t: I longed to drink myself senseless and sleep soundly, but I had no money.
